draft.emotion: straightforward and observational, noticing something that needs a good cleaning
notes: Inflects for gender and number: गंदा (m. sg.), गंदे (m. pl. / oblique), गंदी (f.).
Unlike 'बुरा' (burā, general 'bad'), 'गंदा' when meaning 'bad' suggests something disgusting, vulgar, or mean (e.g., गंदी बात = a nasty/vulgar remark, गंदी आदत = a bad/filthy habit).
